name: Arie Greenleaf
abstract_title: The Relational Construction Theory (RCT) of Time: How Coherence Generates Duration, Collapse, and Consciousness
abstract: The Relational Construction Theory (RCT) of Time Modern science treats time as an external background against which physical and mental events unfold. The Relational Construction Theory (RCT) of Time reverses this view. It proposes that time is not a pre-existing container but an emergent product of relational coherence.
